method: Read-only stat; no symlink traversal. Allocated bytes = st_blocks * 512; shared APFS extents are not measured.
file_detail_scope: History, migration copies, packages, public outputs, ZIP archives, and known history test folders. Other roots have size summaries; batch folder detail is in the batch plan.
csv_duplicate_scope: All regular CSV files under data/jobs; SHA-256 computed for each same-size group. Symlinks excluded. Extra-copy bytes keep one file per group; no deletion suitability implied.
